full_judgment:
2. The plaintiff Md. Harunur Rashid is the sole proprietor of M/S. Ismail & Co. and claims to be a leading manufacturer of plastic goods specially bathroom fittings. He invented four designs to be used as bath room fittings made of plastic. After invention he applied for registration of the same to The Controller of Patents and Designs, Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh. He obtained registration and thereafter became the absolute owner of the said designs. Seeing the newness and attractive quality of the said designs the defendant very recently counterfeited, forged, imitated, infringed and pirated the said registered designs of the Plaintiff causing wrongful loss to him. The plaintiff requested the defendant to desist from his illegal acts, with no effect. The plaintiff, therefore, prayed for a decree for permanent injunction restraining the defendant, his servant and agents to produce any plastic articles consisting of any designs as shown in schedule of the plaint. 

 6. On consideration of the evidence on record the learned District Judge held that the plaintiff has no case insofar as his design of the commode scat cover was concerned as the defendant has also obtained registration of his own design and as the two designs of the plaintiff and the defendant are dissimilar, but insofar as the other designs are concerned he found that the defendant has counterfeited and imitated the same. He held that so long as the registration certificate stands the plaintiff gets protection of sections 47 any 53 of the said Act to guard against piracy of his registered designs. Hence he decreed the suit in part. The prayer for injunction in respect of the plastic commode seat cover was disallowed but the defendant was permanently restrained from manufacturing and marketing the rest of the articles in suit so long as the copyright of the plaintiff over the same remains under the law. 

 12. I do not find any ground for granting Permanent injunction in favour of the plaintiff insofar as the high level and low level ball cocks are concerned. In so far as the plastic siphon is concerned I am of the opinion that the learned District Judge rightly decreed the suit.
